summaryZh: Cartilage Tissue Engineering Laboratory 研究软骨和相关关节组织的生物力学功能、结构、组成与代谢关系，覆盖生长、衰老、骨关节炎和组织修复。研究结合体内外实验、工程模型、压缩剪切摩擦磨损测试，以及调控化学和力学环境的生物反应器。
researchQuestions: 软骨及相关关节组织的功能、结构、组成和代谢如何关联？
如何通过生物工程改善软骨损伤与疾病的预防、诊断和治疗？
methods: 压缩剪切摩擦磨损测试

evidence.quote: The goal of the Cartilage Tissue Engineering Laboratory is to use and advance bioengineering in order to better prevent, diagnose, and treat diseases and injuries of cartilage.

The global objective is to understand the relationships between biomechanical function, structure, composition, and metabolism of cartilage (both articular and septal) and joint tissues (i.e. meniscus and synovium) that interact with cartilage.
We study cartilage by nature (in growth, aging, and osteoarthritis) and by design (in repair, tissue engineering, and joint engineering).
In vitro and in vivo experiments are performed in the context of engineering models
The experiments involve novel compression, shear, friction, and wear test systems
With the use of bioreactors that modulate chemical and mechanical microenvironments
The Cartilage Tissue Engineering Laboratory in the Department of Bioengineering at the University of California, San Diego was formed in July, 1992 by Prof. Robert Sah .
